title: Grilled King Crab Legs Recipe
description: Lemon, garlic, parsley, and lots of butter accent the delectable flavor of king crab legs in this quick and easy recipe for grilled king crab legs.
ingredients: 0.5 cup butter, divided, or more to taste
1 teaspoon sea salt, or more to taste
freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat.

Lay 4 sheets aluminum foil on a work surface; place 1 crab leg on each sheet. Squeeze 1 lemon quarter on each crab leg; place squeezed lemon quarter next to each crab leg. Cut ¼ cup butter into small cubes; divide and place onto crab legs. Sprinkle parsley and garlic on each crab leg; season with salt and black pepper.
Cover each crab leg with remaining sheets aluminum foil; seal aluminum foil together to create sealed packets.
Place packets on the preheated grill; cook until crab legs are bright pink outside and meat is opaque, about 20 minutes.
Melt remaining ¼ cup butter in a small saucepan over low heat; serve with crab.
